schema.origin: where it comes from: a paper (with its docs/specs/sources entry), a failed experiment, a review item, a conjecture of the theory brief
schema.refutation_criterion: quantitative, written before any computation: what result refutes the hypothesis
schema.protocol: data, model, metric and its noise floor, number of seeds (at least 5 for a quoted comparison)
schema.script: path under experiments/, with a --quick mode
schema.cost_estimate: CPU hours (at most 2 per run), GPU euros if any (needs the user's approval)
schema.status: proposed | registered | running | supported | refuted | dropped
schema.comparison: race objective C6: 'constraint mechanisms' or 'model families' when the hypothesis compares them, empty otherwise
schema.seeds: number of model seeds of the quoted comparison (at least 5)

hypotheses.statement: In E1, the equivariant velocity field (C_equivariant) gives a lower energy distance to the reference law on the test Γ than the baseline (A_reference).
hypotheses.origin: E1 published run, 2 seeds: 0.00257 vs 0.0118 (digest, test Γ); review §2.3 (seed counts) and CLAUDE.md rule 4
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(A) − ED(C) is not larger than 2 SE, or if C is below A in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if ED(A) − ED(C) is smaller than the Monte Carlo floor of the energy distance (digest: mc_noise_floors.n_gen.energy).
hypotheses.protocol: E1, test Γ (10 values), energy distance on standardized (Q, D, V), n = 3000 per set, V statistic. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: E1 for 5 seeds: one process per seed, about 1 h each at 2 threads (estimate), no GPU
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test Γ: ED(A) 0.0127, ED(C) 0.0023; paired difference A − C = 0.0104 ± 0.0012 (mean ± SE), 8.8 SE; C below A for 5 of 5 seeds; difference 8.4 times the floor (0.00123). No criterion met: not refuted. Digest: E1, 'Paired comparisons' table.

hypotheses.statement: In E1, fine-tuning with the stationarity loss (F_stationarity_C) lowers the residual of the held-out degree-3 Liouville identities on the test Γ compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (F0_control_C), without degrading the energy distance by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E1 published run, 2 seeds: Liouville deg 3, 0.0113 vs 0.0224 (digest, test Γ); report claims on stationarity losses
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference Liou3(F0) − Liou3(F) is not larger than 2 SE, or if F is below F0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the mean energy distance of F exceeds 1.2 times that of F0.
hypotheses.protocol: E1, test Γ, liouville_residual with MONO_TEST (degree 3, not used in training) and energy distance as in H1. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: included in H1 (same run)
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test Γ: Liouville deg 3, F 0.0338, F0 0.0172; paired difference F0 − F = −0.017 ± 0.013; F below F0 for 2 of 5 seeds; ED(F)/ED(F0) = 1.41. All three criteria met: refuted (verdict pending). Digest: E1, 'Paired comparisons' and 'Per seed, test Γ' tables. Five seeds show no gain; they do not establish a degradation (−1.2 and 1.0 SE).

hypotheses.statement: In E2, the stationarity loss in law (V5_potentials_stat) lowers the energy distance of the generated law on the test η compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (V5_control).
hypotheses.origin: E2 published run, 1 seed: 0.699 vs 2.52 (digest, test η); review §2.3 (one seed) and §2.7 (gain concentrated at large η)
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(V5_control) − ED(V5_potentials_stat) is not larger than 2 SE, or if V5 is below its control in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the gain comes from fewer than 3 of the 5 test η (per-η table of the digest, seed mean).
hypotheses.protocol: E2, test η (5 values), energy distance of the standardized physical features, n = 1000. Training data identical for all seeds; seeds change the networks, the generation and the tilting. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 70 min per seed at 2 threads (published run: 4023 s), 5 processes, no GPU
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test η: ED(V5_control) 2.43, ED(V5) 0.925; paired difference 1.50 ± 0.27, 5.6 SE; V5 below control for 5 of 5 seeds; seed-mean gain at 3 of 5 test η (0.00951, 0.0135, 0.0190), loss at 0.00476 and 0.00673. No criterion met (third one at its limit): not refuted. Digest: E2, 'Paired comparisons' and 'Per test η, over the seeds' tables.

hypotheses.statement: In E4 (3D), generating vector potentials (W4_potentials, constraint by model design) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than generating free components (W0_free).
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest, across seeds: V4_potentials 2.44 against V0_free 4.37 (2D); offer: constraints 'through model design'; Proposition 1.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W0_free) − ED(W4_potentials) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4 is below W0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): W0_free − W4_potentials = −20.05 ± 3.21 (−6.2 SE), W4 below W0 in 0 of 5 seeds, negative at each held-out η; the two CPU seeds agree (−26.9).
hypotheses.results: Free components are better than potentials at this budget: ED ratio 236 against 256 (GPU run, 5 seeds). Both are far from the reference. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the divergence penalty on the end-of-path prediction (W1_penalty, weight 10; constraint by a training loss) does not enforce the constraint: it lowers the relative divergence of B of the free model W0_free by less than a factor 10, and it does not lower the energy-distance ratio.
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest: V1_penalty rel. div. 0.342 (u) and 0.162 (B) against 0.407 for V0, energy distance 5.62 against 4.37; Proposition 3 (the penalty is unbiased at the optimum, which says nothing of a finite network).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed mean of the relative divergence of B of W1 is below one tenth of that of W0, or if ED(W0_free) − ED(W1_penalty) is larger than 2 SE with W1 below W0 in at least 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). Relative divergence: mean over samples of milady.eval.metrics.divergence_relative of B.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): relative divergence of B 0.206 against 0.380 (ratio 0.544, not below one tenth); W0_free − W1_penalty = −228.2 ± 12.7, 0 of 5: the penalty does not enforce the constraint and degrades the law.
hypotheses.results: ED ratio 464 for W1_penalty against 236 for W0_free. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the projected flow (W3_projected_flow: projected noise and projection of every integration stage) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than the Leray projection of the final samples of the free model (W2_final_projection).
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest, paired comparison: V2 − V3 = 0.945 ± 0.0625, 15.1 SE, 5 of 5 seeds; Proposition 2 (only the component in S has to be learnt); offer: constraints through 'sampling procedures'.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W2) − ED(W3) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W3 is below W2 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): W2_final_projection − W3_projected_flow = 2.69 ± 3.72 (0.72 SE), 4 of 5 seeds: no difference at 2 SE; the CPU seeds show the same absence of effect.
hypotheses.results: ED ratio 179 (W2) and 177 (W3). The E2 result (15 SE) is not reproduced in 3D at this budget. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, fine-tuning the equivariant potentials model with the law-level stationarity loss (W5_stationarity: energy identity and magnetic-helicity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0, imposed at every η of the range) lowers the absolute residual of the mean energy balance on the held-out η compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (W5_control), without raising the energy-distance ratio by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E2 hypothesis H3 (not refuted: energy distance 0.925 against 2.43, energy residual 0.069 against 0.447) and E1 hypothesis H2 (refuted: no gain on the held-out identities); claim 1 of docs/specs/theory-brief.md §4; offer: 'energy balance' through 'training losses'.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference |res|(W5_control) − |res|(W5_stationarity) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W5 is below its control in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W5 exceeds 1.2 times that of the control.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). Residual: C3 metric (|E[injection − Dν − Dη]| / E[Dν + Dη]).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): |energy residual| W5_control − W5_stationarity = 0.0988 ± 0.0108 (9.1 SE), 5 of 5 seeds (0.290 → 0.191); ED ratio W5/control = 1.023.
hypotheses.results: The residual stays far from the reference (below 2e-4) and from the Gaussian baseline (0.002). Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, imposing the stationarity identities at training time (W5_stationarity) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than imposing the same identities at sampling time by exponential tilting of the samples of the control model (W7_tilting: multipliers fitted on one half of the samples, the other half evaluated with its weights).
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest: 'in law: tilting' 4.04 against V5_potentials_stat 0.925, ESS/N 0.002 at the three largest test η; Proposition 7 (reweighting does not create mass); offer: 'training losses' against 'sampling procedures'.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W7_tilting) − ED(W5_stationarity) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W5 is below W7 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). W7 is evaluated with milady.eval.metrics.weighted_energy_distance on 256 weighted samples; W5 on the same number of samples.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: NOT DISCRIMINATING (encadrant, 2026-11-12): the registered criterion is formally met (W7_tilting − W5_stationarity_half = 30.0 ± 10.1, 5 of 5), but ESS/N is 1/256 in 14 of 15 cells: the tilted law is one sample and its energy distance is not a measurement of a law; with an estimate of the extra bias of a weighted sample the sign flips (−13.9 ± 9.5). Reading the formal criterion as a support would be wrong; the relabelling is post hoc and left to the owner.
hypotheses.results: Measured fact: exponential tilting on the energy identity collapses (ESS/N 0.004 to 0.008) on generators this far from the law; the comparison of energy distances cannot be made. Reported as a negative result. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the B → −B equivariant velocity field (W4s_potentials_sym, constraint by model design) lowers the polarity asymmetry |P(⟨u·B⟩ > 0) − ½| of the generated law on the held-out η compared with the same model without symmetrization (W4_potentials), without raising the energy-distance ratio by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E1 hypothesis H1 and digest (asymmetry 0.0407 for A_reference against 0.00224 for C_equivariant); Proposition 4; the asymmetry of a finite set of trajectories (E1 digest, training data).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference asym(W4) − asym(W4s) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4s is below W4 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W4s exceeds 1.2 times that of W4.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). Asymmetry: T2 metric, n = 512 (binomial floor 0.018).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12) on its first clause: asymmetry W4 − W4s = 0.0004 ± 0.0058, 3 of 5 seeds, both at or below the binomial floor 0.0176: the test could not discriminate at n = 512. The second clause holds: ED ratio W4s/W4 = 0.819 (−46.5 ± 4.8, 0 of 5).
hypotheses.results: The symmetrized field improves the energy distance (9.6 SE) without any measurable effect on the polarity asymmetry, which the unsymmetrized model already has at the sampling floor. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, conditional flow matching (W4_potentials: linear path, Heun, 100 network evaluations) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than a variance-preserving diffusion with ancestral sampling (W6_diffusion: v-prediction, 100 network evaluations), with the same latent space, network, training budget and seeds.
hypotheses.origin: Offer: 'diffusion or flow matching'; no measurement in this repository before the race.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W6_diffusion) − ED(W4_potentials) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4 is below W6 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED as registered (encadrant, 2026-11-12): W6_diffusion − W4_potentials = 262.4 ± 12.1, 5 of 5, positive at each held-out η. Caveat of the encadrant: at the training η the diffusion model is better than flow matching (−15.06 ± 0.90, 0 of 5): the result is about interpolation in η with the aliased condition embedding, not about the model family at fixed η.
hypotheses.results: ED ratio 519 (W6) against 256 (W4) at held-out η; 160 against 175 at the training η. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In the E4 reference data, the magnetic helicity spectrum is bipolar at every η: H(k = 1) < 0 and Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) > 0, with a large-scale energy fraction E_B(k = 1)/E_B between 0.2 and 0.8, so that the stationarity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = Σ k² H(k) = 0 is a cancellation between the two signs.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C1: α-effect of a forcing with positive kinetic helicity, field at k = 1, forcing at k = 2); identity from d⟨A·B⟩/dt = −2η⟨j·B⟩.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if, at any of the 11 η, H(1) is not negative or Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) is not positive by 2 SE (SE over the trajectory means), or if E_B(1)/E_B falls outside [0.2, 0.8]. Stationarity gate, reported and not a refutation: z = trajectory mean of ⟨j·B⟩ over its SE; |z| > 2 at a value of η means that the identity is not yet stationary there.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 reference data only (24 trajectories per η): shell spectrum of the magnetic helicity, time mean per trajectory, then mean and SE over the trajectories. No model.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of CPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): recomputed from the raw snapshots at the 11 η, independently of the experiment code, every value equal to e4_reference.json. H(1) < 0 at 11 of 11 η (z from −19 to −58) and E_B(1)/E_B in [0.370, 0.438] hold; Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) > 0 by 2 SE fails at η = 0.0365 and 0.03309 (z = −1.4 and −1.2, sign undetermined) and at η = 0.03 (z = −5.5, negative). The criterion is unchanged since commit 68e2fd4.
hypotheses.results: Digest, E4, 'Reference: magnetic helicity spectrum and stationarity identities (H11)'. The sign change of H(k) is not between k = 1 and k = 2: the shell k = 2 (the forcing shell) is negative at every η (12 to 39 SE) and Σ_{k ≥ 3} H is positive at every η (encadrant recomputation, not a registered hypothesis: a post hoc reading). The identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0 holds at every η (|z| ≤ 1.7), as a cancellation between the shells k ≤ 2 and k ≥ 3 with the positive part peaking at k = 4. No model seed: 24 trajectories per η.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the magnetic-helicity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0 constrains the generated magnetic law more than the energy identity: on the samples of W4s_potentials_sym at the held-out η its normalized residual is at least twice that of the energy identity, and tilting on it alone lowers the error on the mean magnetic helicity more than tilting on the energy identity alone.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C2: the energy balance is dominated by u, its sensitivity to an error on B is D_η/(2P) ≈ 0.08-0.15 against 0.5-1.5 for the helicity identity).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed mean of r_b/r_a is below 2, or if r_b > r_a in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the paired difference |err H_M|(tilt a) − |err H_M|(tilt b) is not larger than 2 SE; if ESS/N of the tilt on (b) is below 0.1 the tilting part is reported as a negative result.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). r_a = |E[P − Dν − Dη]| / E[P + Dν + Dη]; r_b = |Σ_k E[J(k)]| / Σ_k |E[J(k)]| with J(k) the shell spectrum of ⟨j·B⟩. Tilting fitted on one half of the samples, evaluated with weights on the other half.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): seed mean of r_b/r_a = 0.504, r_b > r_a in 0 of 5 seeds. The tilting clause is met (|err H_M| tilt a − tilt b = 0.238 ± 0.095, 5 of 5) against a degenerate comparator (tilt on the energy identity: ESS/N 0.0096); tilt b against no tilt gains 0.110 ± 0.049; the two CPU seeds do not agree in sign.
hypotheses.results: The energy identity is violated twice as much as the helicity identity by the generated law, the opposite of the conjecture; tilting on the helicity identity keeps its effective sample size (0.88). Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the error of a generator on the number of magnetic null points follows its error on the magnetic Taylor wavenumber k_λ = (⟨|j|²⟩/⟨|B|²⟩)^½ as N ∝ k_λ³: over all (variant, held-out η, seed) points, the slope of ln(N_gen/N_ref) against ln(k_λ,gen/k_λ,ref) lies between 2 and 4.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C3: Kac-Rice count of the zeros of a solenoidal Gaussian field, N = 4.88 k_λ³ per (2π)³ box in the Gaussian limit, constant from its own Monte Carlo; fewer nulls when the k = 1 field is coherent).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the least-squares slope falls outside [2, 4] or if R² < 0.5. Protocol check first, not a refutation: the null count of the reference must change by less than 10 % between the 48³ and 64³ evaluation grids.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Null points: milady.eval.topology (trilinear method) on fields evaluated on a 48³ grid, 200 snapshots per value.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED on the slope (encadrant, 2026-11-12): slope 4.875, R² 0.902 over 135 points (seed-bootstrap interval [4.83, 4.92]); CPU 4.96. Protocol check passed (reference nulls change by 0.6 to 3.6 % between 48³ and 64³).
hypotheses.results: The null count follows the magnetic Taylor wavenumber steeply (R² 0.90) but not as k_λ³; intercept 1.08: about 2.9 times too many nulls at the right k_λ. Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the relative divergence of the free model W0_free is a representation error of the network and not an integration error (Proposition 2, consequence (c)): on the held-out η it is of order one with 50 Heun steps (above 0.1) and changes by less than 20 % with 200 steps.
hypotheses.origin: docs/specs/theory-brief.md, Proposition 2 (d): 'Reading of E2 (hypothesis, not measured): the relative divergence 0.41 of the free model V0 is a representation error of the network in the sense of (c), not an integration error.'
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean relative divergence of B of W0_free with 50 steps is below 0.1, or if its ratio between 200 and 50 steps falls outside [0.8, 1.2].
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Same noise for the two step counts, n = 128.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): relative divergence of B of W0_free 0.3792 at 50 Heun steps and 0.3788 at 200, ratio 0.998 to 1.000 per seed, above 0.1: integration error is excluded; 'representation error' is the remaining reading, not a separate measurement.
hypotheses.results: Supports the reading of E2 written as a hypothesis in docs/specs/theory-brief.md (Proposition 2, consequence (d)). Digest: 'E4 - replication' (GPU run, 5 seeds), 'Paired comparisons'. Review: research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the error of the generators at the held-out η comes from the embedding of the condition: the Fourier embedding of the pre-race code has frequencies up to 8 cycles over the normalized parameter range, above the Nyquist frequency of the 6 training values (spacing 0.18), so the velocity field is aliased between them. With a smooth embedding (frequencies between 0.5 and 1 cycle; W4c_potentials_smooth), the energy-distance ratio of the potentials model on the held-out η is at least halved.
hypotheses.origin: Failed experiment: first full E4 runs (seeds 0 and 1, logs of 2026-11-12): W0_free and W4_potentials at 200 to 250 times the floor on the held-out η with an error on E_B(k) above 2, worse than the --quick run of 150 iterations; a scratch diagnostic (800 iterations) gives a generated latent 16 % too wide at a held-out η whatever the integration step. The same embedding is used by E1 and E2 (experiments/common.py), where the held-out error is also far above the training error (digest: V4_potentials 2.44 on test η against 1.03 on training η).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W4c_potentials_smooth on the held-out η is more than half that of W4_potentials, or if the paired difference ED(W4) − ED(W4c) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4c is below W4 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, network size, budget, seeds 0-4, n = 512, Heun 50 steps; the only change is the maximum frequency of the condition embedding (ResMLP argument cond_scale: 8 in W4_potentials, 0.5 in W4c_potentials_smooth). Paired difference of the per-seed means over the 3 held-out η; SE = sd(ddof = 1)/sqrt(5). The training-η rows are reported next to the held-out ones.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: one training per seed (15 min of one CPU core, or seconds of GPU), no new data
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-13): ratio of the seed-mean ED ratios W4c/W4 = 215.4/256.3 = 0.84 on the held-out η, above the 0.5 of the criterion; the paired difference ED(W4) − ED(W4c) = 40.9 ± 6.8 (6.0 SE, 5 of 5 seeds) is real, and absent at the training η (0.34 ± 0.32): the embedding of the condition explains part of the interpolation error, not the failure.
hypotheses.results: experiments/results/e4_mhd3d_s<k>.json (main run e4_final, 5 seeds); experiments/results/digest.md, section E4; review research/reviews/2026-11-13-encadrant-e4-final-h15-h20.md

hypotheses.statement: In E4, a conditional Gaussian model with one mean and one covariance per Fourier mode (G0_gaussian_modes: no network; moments estimated at the training η and interpolated linearly in log η, symmetrized under B → −B) has a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than every flow-matching or diffusion generator of the registered protocol (W0 to W6).
hypotheses.origin: Failed experiment: results of the 5 seeds of the GPU replication (experiments/results/replications/e4_gpu, 2026-11-12): W0-W6 at 177 to 519 times the floor on the held-out η and 106 to 275 at the training η, generated fields over-dispersed (σ(dE/dt) 2 to 14 times the reference, 2 to 3 times too many nulls). A second-order baseline was missing from the protocol.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of G0 on the held-out η is above that of any of W0, W2, W3, W4, W4s, W5, W6 (W1 excluded: it is the worst), or if G0 is not below the best of them in at least 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, held-out η, n = 512, metrics and floors. G0 has no training seed: the 5 seeds are those of its sampling noise; it is compared seed by seed with the variants of the main run.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of GPU per seed (no new data)
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED (encadrant, 2026-11-13): G0 3.52 against 177 to 519 for W0–W6 on the held-out η (W3 the lowest, 176.6); best of them per seed 153–194 against G0 3.36–3.70, 5 of 5 seeds.
hypotheses.results: experiments/results/e4_mhd3d_s<k>.json (main run e4_final, 5 seeds); experiments/results/digest.md, section E4; review research/reviews/2026-11-13-encadrant-e4-final-h15-h20.md

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the over-dispersion of the flow-matching generators comes from the bottleneck of the network (width 512 for 5320 latent dimensions), which cannot represent the linear part of the velocity field: adding an explicit mode-wise affine term v = G(t, η) x + b(t, η) + MLP (W9_skip_sym: potentials, B-sign equivariance, smooth condition embedding, same width, depth, iterations and batch as W4s) divides the energy-distance ratio on the held-out η by at least 5 compared with W4s_potentials_sym.
hypotheses.origin: Same failed experiment. The flow-matching loss of W0-W6 stays at 1.60 to 1.63, above π/2 = 1.571, the loss of the exact linear field for independent unit Gaussian coordinates. The same bottleneck exists in E2 for the component models only (dimension 1760, width 1024) and not for the potentials (880), which may confound the E2 comparison V4 against V0 (conjecture, not tested here).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W9_skip_sym on the held-out η is more than one fifth of that of W4s_potentials_sym, or if the paired difference ED(W4s) − ED(W9) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W9 is below W4s in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds. Reported with it: the final flow-matching loss against π/2.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, held-out η, n = 512, metrics and floors. Paired difference of the per-seed means over the 3 held-out η between W9_skip_sym (group D) and W4s_potentials_sym (group B), same seeds; SE = sd(ddof = 1)/sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of GPU per seed (no new data)
hypotheses.verdict: CONFIRMED (encadrant, 2026-11-13): ratio W9/W4s = 9.35/209.8 = 0.045, below 0.2; ED(W4s) − ED(W9) = 200.4 ± 2.2 (91 SE), 5 of 5 seeds; flow-matching loss of W9 on a training sample 1.18, below π/2. The factor is 22.4 at the held-out η and 30.2 at the training η.
hypotheses.results: experiments/results/e4_mhd3d_s<k>.json (main run e4_final, 5 seeds); experiments/results/digest.md, section E4; review research/reviews/2026-11-13-encadrant-e4-final-h15-h20.md

hypotheses.statement: In E4, flow matching adds to the second-order baseline what a Gaussian law cannot hold: with the mode-wise affine term and a longer training (W9L_skip_long, 8 times the iterations of W9), the drift of the magnetic energy when the solver is restarted from the generated snapshots (T1 metric) and the error on the number of magnetic null points are both lower than those of G0_gaussian_modes.
hypotheses.origin: A Gaussian law with independent modes has no triple correlation, hence no energy transfer between scales at the first instant of a restart, and its null count follows the Gaussian estimate (physicien, conjecture C3 of 2026-11-12).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if, for the restart drift or for the null-count error, the paired difference G0 − W9L is not larger than 2 SE or W9L is below G0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, held-out η, n = 512, metrics and floors. Restart drift on 128 snapshots per held-out η over τ = 4; null count on 200 snapshots at 48³. Paired by seed (training seed of W9L, sampling seed of G0).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of GPU per seed (no new data)

hypotheses.statement: In E4, a flow-matching field anchored on the exact field of the mode-wise Gaussian law, v = v_Gauss(x, t, η) + network (W10_anchored: the network starts at zero, so the model starts as G0 and learns only the non-Gaussian correction), keeps the second-order accuracy of G0 and adds what G0 lacks: its energy-distance ratio on the held-out η is not above that of G0_gaussian_modes, and its restart drift and its null-count error are both below those of G0.
hypotheses.origin: CPU runs of group D on seeds 0 and 1 (2026-11-12): G0 at 3.3 times the floor with an energy residual of 0.002 but 3.3 times too many nulls and a restart drift of 0.21; W9_skip_sym (learned affine term, 4000 iterations) at 9 to 11 times the floor with fewer nulls (error 1.7) and a smaller drift (0.11 to 0.14): the learned linear part is less accurate than the analytic one, the non-Gaussian part is better. For Gaussian data the optimal field is known in closed form: v*(x, t) = μ + (tΣ − (1 − t)I)(t²Σ + (1 − t)²I)⁻¹(x − tμ).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W10_anchored on the held-out η exceeds that of G0 by more than 2 SE of the paired difference, or if, for the restart drift or for the null-count error, the paired difference G0 − W10 is not larger than 2 SE or W10 is below G0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, held-out η, n = 512, metrics and floors. W10_anchored: potentials, B-sign equivariance, smooth condition embedding, ResMLP 512×4, 4000 iterations, batch 128 (the budget of W4s); W10L_anchored_long (8 times the iterations, GPU) is reported with it. Paired by seed with G0 (sampling seed) on the same data.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of GPU per seed (no new data)
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-13): ED(W10) − ED(G0) = +40.0 ± 0.26 on the held-out η (first clause not met); restart drift of E_B: G0 − W10 = 0.090 ± 0.003, 5 of 5 (met); null-count error: G0 − W10 = −0.229 ± 0.014, 0 of 5 (not met).
hypotheses.results: experiments/results/e4_mhd3d_s<k>.json (main run e4_final, 5 seeds); experiments/results/digest.md, section E4; review research/reviews/2026-11-13-encadrant-e4-final-h15-h20.md

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the anchored model fails (W10_anchored on CPU seeds 0 and 1: 45 times the floor against 3.3 for G0) because the network's own linear component perturbs the second-order statistics that the fixed Gaussian field had right. Adding to the anchored field a learnable mode-wise affine correction, zero at initialization (W11_anchored_skip: v = v_Gauss + G(t, η) x + b(t, η) + network), restores them: its energy-distance ratio on the held-out η is not above that of G0_gaussian_modes, and its restart drift and its null-count error are both below those of G0.
hypotheses.origin: CPU runs of groups D and E on seeds 0 and 1 (2026-11-12, container data): G0 3.3; W9_skip_sym (learned affine term + network) 9.1 and 10.6; W10_anchored (exact Gaussian field + network) 44.7 and 46.3 with an energy residual of 0.15: the learned affine term of W9 can compensate the linear part of the network, the fixed anchor of W10 cannot.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W11_anchored_skip on the held-out η exceeds that of G0 by more than 2 SE of the paired difference, or if, for the restart drift or for the null-count error, the paired difference G0 − W11 is not larger than 2 SE or W11 is below G0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H19, same budget as W4s (ResMLP 512×4, 4000 iterations, batch 128), 5 seeds, paired with G0 on the same data. W11L_anchored_skip_long (8 times the iterations, GPU) is reported with it.
hypotheses.script: experiments/e4_mhd3d.py --seed k --group D,E (and L for the long variants), k = 0..4
hypotheses.cost_estimate: minutes of GPU per seed (no new data)
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-13) on its first clause: ED(W11) − ED(G0) = +5.08 ± 0.22 (24 SE), 0 of 5 seeds; the two other clauses are met: restart drift of E_B G0 − W11 = 0.092 ± 0.003 (5 of 5), null-count error G0 − W11 = 0.539 ± 0.014 (5 of 5). Reported with it: the magnetic energy balance residual is 0.998 for G0 against 0.060 for W11, and the restart drift of E_u is lower for G0 (0.026 against 0.053).
hypotheses.results: experiments/results/e4_mhd3d_s<k>.json (main run e4_final, 5 seeds); experiments/results/digest.md, section E4; review research/reviews/2026-11-13-encadrant-e4-final-h15-h20.md

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the over-dispersion of the flow-matching generators without an explicit linear term comes from the width of the network and not from the training budget: for the equivariant potentials model with the smooth condition embedding and no affine term, (i) the energy-distance ratio on the held-out η decreases with the width over 512, 2048 and 5632 (the last one above the latent dimension 5320) at 4000 iterations, the widest being at most one fifth of the narrowest, and (ii) 8 times the iterations at width 512 do not bring the ratio below half its value at 4000 iterations.
hypotheses.origin: encadrant, review of 2026-11-12 23:05 UTC (research/reviews/2026-11-12-encadrant-e4-registered-protocol.md): 'cause = width below the latent dimension' is a conjecture; it is refuted if width 512 trained longer goes below π/2, if a width above the latent dimension stays above it, or if a width scan shows no monotone trend. H17 tests the remedy (explicit affine term); this hypothesis tests the cause.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean ratios at 4000 iterations are not ordered S_w512 > S_w2048 > S_w5632, or if S_w5632 is above one fifth of S_w512, or if S_w512_long (32000 iterations) is below half of S_w512. Reported with it: the flow-matching loss of each on a training sample against π/2.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, held-out η, n = 512, metrics and floors. Variants of group S: SignSymmetrized ResMLP, depth 4, cond_scale 0.5, widths 512, 2048, 5632 at 4000 iterations and widths 512, 2048 at 32000 iterations, batch 128, lr 5e-4. Five seeds; means over the 3 held-out η, then over the seeds.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: one GPU job of at most 2 h on a 48 GB card (the widest network has 0.5 billion parameters)
